translations.web: They pour out arrogant words. All the evildoers boast.
translations.bsb: They pour out arrogant words; all workers of iniquity boast.
translations.kjv: How long shall they utter and speak hard things? and all the workers of iniquity boast
translations.asv: They prate, they speak arrogantly: All the workers of iniquity boast themselves.
